doc:
# Error Correction — Bulk Reconstruction

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “holographic quantum error correction”).

claims.name: errorcorrection_behavior_closely_related_modeling
claims.statement: The error-correction behavior is closely related to modeling the holographic map as a quantum error correction code.

sources.title: Real-space RG, error correction and Petz map

claims.name: superadditivity_proposed_mechanism_explaining_success
claims.statement: Superadditivity is proposed as the mechanism explaining success of holographic quantum error-correction models.

sources.title: Superadditivity in large $N$ field theories and performance of quantum tasks

claims.name: holographicslice_picture_related_idea_holographic
claims.statement: The holographic-slice picture is related to the idea that the holographic dictionary works as quantum error correction.

sources.title: Coarse-Graining Holographic States: A Semiclassical Flow in General Spacetimes

claims.name: argue_manypartite_entanglement_ubiquitous_holography
claims.statement: We argue that many-partite entanglement is ubiquitous in holography and holographic quantum error correction codes.

sources.title: Why many-partite entanglement is essential for holography

claims.name: entanglementwedge_reconstruction_based_holographic_quantum
claims.statement: Entanglement-wedge reconstruction based on holographic quantum error correction is argued invalid under nonperturbative finite-$N$ or quantum-gravity effects.

claims.name: sandwiched_renyi_relative_entropy_plays
claims.statement: Sandwiched Renyi relative entropy plays a role in AdS/CFT and in finite-dimensional models of holographic quantum error correction.

sources.title: Sandwiched Renyi Relative Entropy in AdS/CFT

claims.name: quantum_causal_influence_exhibited_hamiltonian
claims.statement: Quantum causal influence is exhibited in Hamiltonian evolution, quantum error correction codes, quantum teleportation, holographic tensor networks, and the final state projection model of black holes.

claims.name: geometric_deformations_warped_curved_text
claims.statement: Geometric deformations in warped and curved $\text{AdS}_3$ backgrounds influence holographic duals in relation to entanglement and quantum error correction.

sources.title: Anyonic Excitations in Warped and Curved AdS Backgrounds

claims.name: holographic_quantum_errorcorrecting_codes_logarithmic
claims.statement: In holographic quantum error-correcting codes, the logarithmic negativity is equivalent to the cross-sectional area of entanglement wedges with a bulk quantum correction term.

sources.title: Entanglement negativity and minimal entanglement wedge cross sections in holographic theories

claims.name: holographic_codes_have_specific_advantage
claims.statement: Holographic codes have a specific advantage over topological codes due to no-go theorems regarding fractal noise in topological quantum error correction.

sources.title: Code Properties of the Holographic Sierpinski Triangle

claims.name: sandwiched_renyi_relative_entropy_defined
claims.statement: The sandwiched Renyi relative entropy defined in terms of modular operators is naturally suited to finite-dimensional models of holographic quantum error correction.

sources.title: Sandwiched Renyi Relative Entropy in AdS/CFT

claims.name: restriction_strength_holographic_quantum_error
claims.statement: The restriction on the strength of the holographic quantum error correction procedure is partially removed when the transition to a deconfined phase occurs.

claims.name: brane_configuration_bulk_corresponding_confinement
claims.statement: The brane configuration in the bulk corresponding to the confinement phase imposes a restriction on the strength of the holographic quantum error correction procedure.

claims.name: point_out_connection_between_emergence
claims.statement: We point out a connection between the emergence of bulk locality in AdS/CFT and the theory of quantum error correction. Bulk notions such as Bogoliubov transformations, location in the radial direction, and the holographic entropy bound all have natural CFT interpretations in the language of quantum error correction.

sources.title: Bulk Locality and Quantum Error Correction in AdS/CFT

claims.name: quantum_null_energy_condition_used
claims.statement: The quantum null energy condition is used to address storage of quantum information at finite temperature with minimal active error correction in two-dimensional holographic conformal field theories.

sources.title: Erasure tolerant quantum memory and the quantum null energy condition in holographic systems

claims.name: boundary_subregion_shape_sierpinski_gasket
claims.statement: A boundary subregion in the shape of the Sierpinski gasket in $\text{AdS}_5/\text{CFT}_4$ does not possess holographic quantum error correction properties.

sources.title: Code Properties of the Holographic Sierpinski Triangle

claims.name: when_bulk_operator_order_ads
claims.statement: When a bulk operator is of order an AdS radius distance from the causal wedge $\mathcal{W}_C[\overline{A}]$, the approximate equivalence between conventional quantum error correction and operator algebra quantum error correction requires sub-AdS scale bulk locality, a special property of those CFTs that have local holographic duals.

sources.title: Bulk Locality and Quantum Error Correction in AdS/CFT

claims.name: holographic_theories_interpreted_via_quantum
claims.statement: In holographic theories interpreted via quantum error correction, entanglement wedge reconstruction, the Jafferis-Lewkowycz-Maldacena-Suh formula, radial commutativity, and the Ryu-Takayanagi formula are taken to be equivalent.

sources.title: Adding the algebraic Ryu-Takayanagi formula to the algebraic reconstruction theorem
